notes: CAIRN 0.7d - PRE-RELEASE (alpha). Round-10 audit fixes land as one build: the owner claim is token-free only for a browser DIRECT on the box (proxy/tunnel headers now defeat the loopback exception); header and body reads get a real wall-clock budget (an idle timeout is not a deadline); vault key files are vetted for size, entropy, permissions, and wrong-key (KCV), pointer writes are atomic and O_NOFOLLOW, memory-backed filesystems are refused as key homes; a backup that would silently miss sealed secrets now fails closed (resend with allow_vault_loss to accept); a missing or broken crypto import no longer kills the daemon (the updater fails closed instead). INSTALL S3 now matches how the wizard actually behaves. Upgrade contract unchanged: pre-0.7b builds cannot auto-stage this release (smoke-boot fails closed, live files untouched) - upgrade manually per INSTALL; 0.7b+ auto-update normally. This build is ALPHA: auto-update remains owner-confirmed, databases are never auto-restored, and pre-release builds may break. Crossers from 0.6x: run the migration ferry (cairn-migrate.py, --dry-run first).
